# 247 Gulf Trivia

> > Your comprehensive guide to career opportunities across the Gulf region, featuring job openings in UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, and Saudi Arabia.

247 Gulf Trivia aggregates employment opportunities from leading companies and organizations throughout the Middle East, covering industries from hospitality and aviation to oil & gas, engineering, and government services. The platform connects job seekers with major employers including Emirates, Qatar Airways, SABIC, Marriott, Siemens, and many others across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Kuwait City, Doha, and Bahrain.
